resources.string: Send voice messages to a verified target bot using your Telegram account. Saving settings or signing in never sends a message.
Save encrypted settings / Start Telegram connection
Enter the email information below only when the authentication status requests it.
Find target bot and confirm recipient
Log out of Telegram / Revoke session
API ID must be a number greater than zero.
API Hash must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
Enter the phone number in international format, for example +8210XXXXXXXX.
The bot username must contain 5–32 letters, numbers, or underscores.
Encrypted settings saved. No message was sent.
Display over other apps: %1$s Microphone: %2$s Notifications: %3$s
Allow display over other apps, microphone, and notification permissions first.
Complete Telegram sign-in and confirm the target bot first.
Floating button started. Tap once to record, then tap again to send.
Could not start the floating button: %1$s
This revokes the Telegram session on this device. The floating button stops first; recordings that are sending or failed are not deleted.
Ready — tap the floating button to record
Display over other apps permission is required
Could not create the recording folder
Recording — tap again to stop and send
Could not stop recording normally. File retained at: %1$s
Voice message queued — the file is retained until success is confirmed
The floating button stopped while recording. File retained at: %1$s
Floating recording status for sending Telegram voice messages
Type multiple lines here. Text is not sent or saved.
The Telegram connection has not started.
The Telegram connection is already running. The changed settings were saved.
Starting the encrypted Telegram user session…
Phone number input is not currently requested.
Email address input is not currently requested.
Email authentication code input is not currently requested.
Telegram authentication code input is not currently requested.
Two-step verification password input is not currently requested.
Complete Telegram sign-in before finding the target bot.
The username changed, so the earlier bot search result was ignored.
Could not find the bot: Telegram error %1$d: %2$s
Received an unexpected response from the bot search.
The search result was not a private bot chat and was not saved as the target.
The settings changed, so the earlier bot confirmation result was ignored.
Found the chat but could not confirm that it is a bot: Telegram error %1$d: %2$s
The searched user was not a Telegram bot and was not saved as the target.
Telegram connection or target confirmation is incomplete. Recording retained at: %1$s
The recording file is missing or empty, so it was not sent.
The target settings changed immediately before sending, so nothing was sent. Recording retained at: %1$s
Voice message queued (temporary message %1$d). The file is retained until success is confirmed.
Voice message was rejected: Telegram error %1$d: %2$s. Recording retained at: %3$s
Unexpected send response. Recording retained at: %1$s
There is no Telegram session to log out.
Logging out of Telegram and revoking this device session…
Could not log out: Telegram error %1$d: %2$s
Logout request accepted. Waiting for the session to close.
Voice message sent — the local recording was deleted.
Voice message sent, but the local file could not be deleted: %1$s
Voice message failed: Telegram error %1$d: %2$s. Recording retained at: %3$s
Enter the Telegram account phone number, then tap Submit phone number.
Telegram requires an email address. The email address is not saved.
Enter the authentication code received by email. The code is not saved.
Enter the authentication code received from Telegram. The code is not saved.
Enter the Telegram two-step verification password. The password is not saved.
Telegram sign-in complete — find the target bot and confirm the recipient.
The Telegram session is closed. Sign in again to continue.

Telegram API ID and API Hash are required.
